<!-- pr-reviewer: fe19ffbe4bbc6b0e9e13c37d6387209023e62976 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

Reviewed head fe19ffb against current main (010bca6), trial-merged locally.

### What looks good
- The closed form is kept as the first guess and returned unchanged when it already clears (`crates/motion/src/drilling/cross.rs`, `traverse_s`), so on-centre chains and goldens do not move.
- The off-centre case is measured, not assumed: `chord_reach` takes the segment-to-spindle distance between the two real hop points, the plane grows until it clears, then bisects. The returned plane is always one that was verified clear, so the bisection cannot return an unchecked value.
- Degenerate cases are bounded: the doubling loop is capped at 64 steps, the bisection at 60, a non-finite reach becomes 0 (not clear), and "no plane clears" returns `None`, which takes the existing detour or refusal path.
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` or `as` casts added in `src`. `cross.rs` is 345 lines.
- The refusal test is replaced by one that pins the fixed behaviour (`drilling_cross_stock::a_station_change_with_mouths_off_their_centre_lines_hops_clear`); the test count is unchanged (one out, one in).

### Local results (trial merge with main)
| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-app --test drilling_cross` | 9 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test drilling_cross_box` | 7 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test drilling_cross_rapids` | 2 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test drilling_cross_spindle` | 7 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test drilling_cross_stock` | 8 passed (includes the new pin) |
| `camcraft-app --test lathe_cross_drill` | 5 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test drilling_cross_holder` | 2 passed (see note 1) |
| `camcraft-app --test drilling_cross_part` | 3 passed (see note 1) |
| `camcraft-motion --tests` (build only) | builds |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --lib -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

### Requested before merge
None.

### Questions / notes (not blocking)
1. Main does not build `crates/app/tests/drilling_cross_holder.rs` and `drilling_cross_part.rs`: both build `Operation` without the `coolant` field that `crates/app/src/schema.rs:176` now has (`error[E0063]: missing field 'coolant'`). This PR does not touch them. To run them I added `coolant: Default::default()` to both files locally in the review worktree only, ran them (all pass), and reverted. The maintainer should fix this on main separately.
2. The branch is behind main on `RECOMMENDED.md` (append-only conflict). On merge, keep both sides.
3. The `RECOMMENDED.md` decision for #81 is recorded as the PR says.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
